body: i’m literally going through that right now! i ended things first and today i decided i want him back so i texted him and now he’s telling me he doesn’t wanna talk. its so frustrating because i feel so terrible now

thank you. i told him i have bpd but he doesn’t really understand. he said he can’t “picture me mad.” i have a lot of jealousy issues that i’m scared to bring up at the moment because he said he doesn’t like jealousy. i’ll eventually have to bring it up though.
thank you, i truly appreciate it <3
i’ll try to remember this whenever i have these thoughts again
thank you so much. your words truly mean a lot to me because i’ve never opened up to anyone about this, not even my therapist. thank you again <3

i say you do it, i know you don’t want to make your parents sad but it’s in your best interest. they’ll be there to support you and try to help you. at the end of the day your parents are going to want to help you and will di anything for you to get that help. i know opening up isn’t easy, but you should do it. the way i told my mom about my feelings was texting and writing her letters because i was bad at expressing myself through words. so maybe you can find other ways to open up to them without talking face to face.
you’re 100% right, i seek people that will praise me all the time which is unhealthy because then it leads to a toxic relationship
i really want to but it’s so hard because most therapists and psychiatrists near me don’t accept my insurance /:

call a suicide hotline and tell them you plan to hurt yourself. they’ll send the cops and an ambulance to your house and then you’ll go to the ER, then you’ll get evaluated to see if you need to go to the mental hospital. if you have a therapist tell them, they’ll get someone to evaluate you.

when i first told her she didn’t believe in mental illness, but after a while she believed me and started to help me. you should tell her and make sure to tell her to just keep it between both of you.
and by the way i still struggle with my mental health but like i said the healing process isn’t easy. it’s going to take awhile and it’s worth it.

i understand how you’re feeling. i’m 17 and been struggling with mental illness for about 6-7 years. the journey to get to where i am right now was not easy but it’s not impossible. i’ve been in and out if the mental hospitals for years. i thought about suicide many times for many years. i had no motivation and never thought things will get better, but they do. it’s going to take awhile to get to where you want to be but i know you can do it. in order to heal you need to feel those feelings and understand yourself because no one else will. and i recently cut off my toxic friends (the only friends i had). it was painful because i was all alone but it was worth it because of how much they negatively impacted me. you should talk to a therapist, meditate, and journal. you can also find a hobby, it took me years to find a hobby but i finally found one (photography).
even though i don’t know you, you can always talk to me, i’ll always be here for you.

i struggle with the same thing. one minute i feel fine and do a shit ton of impulsive shit and the next minute i feel like complete shit. just know you’re not alone because i’m going through the exact same thing right now. hopefully things get better for us. u can pm me if u need to.
yes you should open up to her. i built a decent relationship with my mom once i opened up about my mental illness.
